page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block at top; woodcut of a tree with animals below it; printer's note in italic script below the woodcut; imprint in capitals at foot. No margin text. A handwritten number and mark at top right are not printed.
page.notes: Woodcut of a tree with animals at its base, between the title and the printer's note. Handwritten number "2" and a underline stroke at top right are manuscript, not printed. The printer's note "Ex dō typographi" is in a handwritten-style italic; read as printed.
